title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Human Resources Manager (Middle level)
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.

We are currently seeking an HR Manager to join our HR and Operations team. This role is crucial in building and scaling our HR functions across LATAM countries.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus
  • Client-facing experience
  • Advanced level of English
  • Great interpersonal and influencing skills
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other
  • applications
  • Time management skills and ability to complete tasks efficiently
  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Good level of emotional intelligence
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Learning agility
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Cultural Competence
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Can-do attitude
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills


Why You Should Work at TurnKey

  • We’re building a diverse team of talented individuals who bring different perspectives to the business and who feel a sense of inclusion and belonging when they join our team
  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together
  • Access to a special online shop where you can use TurnKey coins to purchase exclusive branded items and fun merchandise

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Frontend - Sênior
description:
Esperamos que você:

  • Traduza necessidades de produto e design em entregas técnicas escaláveis e bem estruturadas;
  • Garanta excelência técnica nos componentes, fluxos de publicação e documentação, mantendo alta qualidade, performance e usabilidade;
  • Promova cultura de boas práticas de engenharia, acessibilidade e inner-source.


O que você vai fazer

  • Atuar com migração da stack de CSS-in-JS, otimização de performance e SSR, manutenção e organização de monorepo, estruturação de bundling, CI/CD e publicação de pacotes;
  • Trabalhar de forma colaborativa com pessoas de Produto, Design, Dados e Engenharia, promovendo alinhamento e entregas integradas;
  • Contribuir para uma documentação clara, acessível e de fácil uso por outros squads.


Requisitos

  • Proficiência com TypeScript e React;
  • Experiência com ferramentas CSS-in-JS (ex: styled-components, Emotion, etc.);
  • Vivência com monorepos (ex: Lerna, Nx, Turborepo);
  • Experiência com testes unitários e end-to-end;
  • Conhecimento em acessibilidade Web (padrões WCAG).


Diferenciais que somam pontos

  • Experiência em atuar com Design System e Design Tokens;
  • Vivência em migração de ferramentas CSS-in-JS;
  • Familiaridade com CI/CD (ex: GitHub Actions, Chromatic);
  • Implementação e manutenção de Storybook;
  • Testes de regressão visual;
  • Participação em comunidades técnicas, open source ou iniciativas internas de melhoria contínua.


O que oferecemos

  • Ambiente desafiador com impacto real em produtos utilizados por milhões de pessoas;
  • Colaboração direta com designers, devs e líderes técnicos altamente capacitados;
  • Cultura de engenharia baseada em aprendizado contínuo, autonomia e excelência.


Se você se identifica com esse desafio e quer construir soluções de escala com propósito, vem com a gente!

title: SAP Technical Cutover Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Technical Cutover Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


'Key Responsibilities

Co-lead end-to-end SAP technical activities with K-C leadership and PMO to guide the project team’s efforts to successfully go-live with localization and deployment of a previously built greenfield global template of SAP S/4HANA in the RISE private cloud in MS Azure to K-C business segments in Asia.• Lead and coordinate technical SAP localization and deployment tasks throughout the life of the project including technical landscape readiness, completion of remaining SAP build configuration and development activities and completion of technical activities to localize SAP S/4HANA according to regional requirements in Asia.• Collaborate with K-C leadership, project managers, functional leads, technical platform leads, SAP developers, and business stakeholders to complete all technical activities in a pre-planned and pre-defined sequence to ensure alignment with project goals, milestones and specific deliverables.• Manage and document traceability between technical requirements, business requirements, completion of deliverables that meet requirements, testing activities and defect resolution through go-live and into hypercare.• Provide leadership and mentorship to other cutover business and technical team members and adhere to SAP S/4HANA cutover best practices and standards.

Track and report technical cutover preparation and progress, risks, actions, issues and decisions to project leadership through the Microsoft Asure DevOps (ADO) project management tool, meetings, emails and project documents.


Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in SAP technical cutover management, with at least 5 years in a technical cutover or related technical leadership role.

Strong understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, BW and more) and their integration points.

Prior hands-on experience with SAP configuration, development, implementation troubleshooting and resolution of technical defects is required for this Technical Cutover Manager to manage all technical activities of other technical cutover resources.

Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.


Preferred Skills

Experience with prior projects with a successful cutover to go-live with SAP S/4HANA.

Familiarity with Agile and hybrid waterfall and Agile project methodologies.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Backend - Sênior (Python)
description:
O seu papel como Software Engineer Senior (E3)

  • Desenvolver soluções de ponta a ponta em Python , desde a definição de arquitetura até testes e rollout em produção;
  • Projetar e evoluir sistemas com foco em automação , direcionados à eficiência operacional do grupo SBF;
  • Garantir funcionalidade, manutenibilidade, escalabilidade e qualidade , aplicando boas práticas de engenharia e testes;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, com pair programming, feedbacks contínuos e cultura de alta performance .


O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo

  • Proficiência avançada em Python (orientação a objetos, concorrência, boas práticas de código);
  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes para implantação escalável de modelos e serviços;
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento aplicados a sistemas de IA e automação;
  • Sólida prática em testes unitários, integração e validação de modelos;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo , com autonomia;
  • Embasamento teórico em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina e boas práticas de engenharia de software (DDD, design de código, paradigmas);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).


Seria legal se você conhecesse

  • Google Cloud AI/ML Services (Vertex AI, AI Platform);
  • Continuous Integration & Delivery aplicados a ML (CI/CD para pipelines de dados e modelos);
  • Ferramentas de processamento de dados em streaming (Kafka, Pub/Sub);
  • Boas práticas de DataOps e integração com times de dados e automação.

title: SAP Technical Cutover Manager
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!


Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for SAP Technical Cutover Manager who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


'Key Responsibilities

Co-lead end-to-end SAP technical activities with K-C leadership and PMO to guide the project team’s efforts to successfully go-live with localization and deployment of a previously built greenfield global template of SAP S/4HANA in the RISE private cloud in MS Azure to K-C business segments in Asia.• Lead and coordinate technical SAP localization and deployment tasks throughout the life of the project including technical landscape readiness, completion of remaining SAP build configuration and development activities and completion of technical activities to localize SAP S/4HANA according to regional requirements in Asia.• Collaborate with K-C leadership, project managers, functional leads, technical platform leads, SAP developers, and business stakeholders to complete all technical activities in a pre-planned and pre-defined sequence to ensure alignment with project goals, milestones and specific deliverables.• Manage and document traceability between technical requirements, business requirements, completion of deliverables that meet requirements, testing activities and defect resolution through go-live and into hypercare.• Provide leadership and mentorship to other cutover business and technical team members and adhere to SAP S/4HANA cutover best practices and standards.

Track and report technical cutover preparation and progress, risks, actions, issues and decisions to project leadership through the Microsoft Asure DevOps (ADO) project management tool, meetings, emails and project documents.


Required Qualifications

5+ years of experience in SAP technical cutover management, with at least 5 years in a technical cutover or related technical leadership role.

Strong understanding of SAP modules (e.g., FI/CO, MM, SD, PP, WM, BW and more) and their integration points.

Prior hands-on experience with SAP configuration, development, implementation troubleshooting and resolution of technical defects is required for this Technical Cutover Manager to manage all technical activities of other technical cutover resources.

Excellent communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

Strong critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.


Preferred Skills

Experience with prior projects with a successful cutover to go-live with SAP S/4HANA.

Familiarity with Agile and hybrid waterfall and Agile project methodologies.


What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!


#Buildingonbelief

title: Especialista Salesforce
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Sobre o Cargo: Especialista Salesforce


Responsabilidades:

Perfil de liderança

Desenvolver soluções customizadas na plataforma Salesforce utilizando Apex, LWC (Lightning Web Components), Visualforce e triggers.

Implementar integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST/SOAP.

Criar automações avançadas, componentes reutilizáveis e testes unitários com alta cobertura.

Otimizar queries e gerenciar limites da plataforma (governor limits).

Colaborar com times funcionais e administradores para entrega de soluções técnicas aderentes aos requisitos de negócio.

Apoiar a gestão do ciclo de vida de desenvolvimento (DevOps), incluindo controle de versões e deploys com ferramentas como SFDX, Git e pipelines de CI/CD


Requisitos:

Domínio de todas as etapas do ciclo no Salesforce

Experiência prévia em projetos Salesforce (atuando como desenvolvedor).

Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban) e em squads multidisciplinares.

Experiência prática com integrações complexas e grandes volumes de dados.


Desejável experiência em projetos de implementação de soluções escaláveis em empresas de médio e grande porte.



Modelo de trabalho:

100% remoto

CLT

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão flash

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).

The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).

  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for Data Scientist who wants to learn and transform his career.


In this role you will: (responsibilities)


Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving

Structure complex problems methodically

Modeling techniques, and experimental validation to deliver results

Communication Skills: capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

CI/CD pipelines

AWS

Big Data (Spark, cloud storage, Big Query, etc.)

Designs robust, scalable APIs, handles auth & versioning

Extracting insights from data to support business decisions.

Data wrangling

Statistical analysis

Design ML systems, evaluate trade-offs

Leads innovation with GenAI, custom model development

What can you expect from us?


• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.


What do we offer?


TCS Benefits – Brazil:

Health insurance

Dental Plan

Life insurance

Transportation vouchers

Meal/Food Voucher

Childcare assistance

Gympass

TCS Cares – free 0800 that provides psychological assistance (24 hrs/day), legal, social and financial assistance to associates

Partnership with SESC

Reimbursement of Certifications

Free TCS Learning Portal – Online courses and live training

International experience opportunity

Discount Partnership with Universities and Language Schools

Bring Your Buddy – By referring people you become eligible to receive a bonus for each hire

TCS Gems – Recognition for performance

Xcelerate – Free Mentoring Career Platform


At TATA Consultancy Services we promote an inclusive culture, we always work for equity. This applies to Gender, People with Disabilities, LGBTQIA+, Religion, Race, Ethnicity. All our opportunities are based on these principles. We think of different actions of inclusion and social responsibility, in order to build a TCS that respects individuality. Come to be a TCSer!

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Proactively recruit and develop effective local partnerships with merchandise partners, manufacturers, and brands. Focus on categories selections to increase overall value, in alignment with business and customer needs.
  • Assist merchandise partners in establishing themselves on the platform and their growth.Guide merchandise partners in developing comprehensive plans including market positioning, product planning, brand marketing, and operational strategies.
  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.


Required skills / Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.
  • Extensive connections and relationships with local seller and vendor networks is a plus.
  • Strong data analysis skills, able to analyze industry trends and project management through data, and summarize conclusions.
  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.

title: Data Scientist - Fluent English
description:
The current vacancy is for the Brazilian office and we work in a Free Office model.

Who we are

At Artefact LatAm, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy!

A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued.

Our commitment is to build a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief.

We want incredible minds and hearts to join us! Come be Artefact!

What you will be doing:

You will join our Data and Consulting team, which helps clients transform and improve their data strategy by applying advanced analytics to generate insights that create business value from big data and artificial intelligence.

  • Innovate. You will work with your team, consisting of consultants, data scientists, and engineers, to identify client needs and define innovative solutions.
  • Learn and Share. You will work in a collaborative team that promotes knowledge sharing. You will learn from others, share knowledge, and stay up to date with industry news/updates
  • Develop. You will be involved in the solution from start to finish. With the help of senior scientists, you will manage the design and implementation, as well as optimize performance and scalability.
  • Work across the entire project value chain (data collection and processing, exploratory data analysis, application of machine learning models, model production)
  • Demystify technical terms or solutions for more business-oriented profiles, can work in a team with very diverse profiles
  • Prioritize your tasks, respect deadlines, and raise your hand in case of risks or problems

What we are looking for:
Having completed an undergraduate course in data science, machine learning, mathematics, computer science, statistics, engineering, economics, or a related field.

  • Desirable a first knowledge in statistics and programming (Python/R).
  • Curiosity: you are always looking for innovative solutions for your clients. You are involved in the entire value chain.
  • Collaboration: knowledge sharing is essential for you and you actively participate in the dissemination of information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: you bring solutions, new ideas, innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment

What we offer:

  • Meal/Transportation Allowance (VR/VT)
  • Free Office (work from home or anywhere you want!)
  • Gympass
  • Insurance: Life, Health, and Dental
  • Bi-monthly Meetings (our “Get Together” where we meet to be together, with workshops, lectures, training, and a happy hour!)
  • Woba (you can book coworking spaces anywhere you want!)
  • Semi-annual evaluations (with opportunities for promotion)


Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be:  come and build the future of marketing
  • Progress:  every day offers new challenges and new opportunities to learn
  • Culture:  join the best team you could ever imagine
  • Entrepreneurship:  you will be joining a team of driven entrepreneurs. We won’t give up until we make a huge dent in this industry!

Come join us!

title: SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS)
description:
You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. That’s the spirit of the community you’ll find at Orbia: where the purpose to advance life around the world drives our global team of over 23,000 every single day.

From creating solutions to deliver clean water, secure food supplies and reliable information to steering material advances that power the future of green and smart cities, transportation, and healthcare, we never settle for “good enough” when there’s an opportunity to make life better. Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we live for.


Fluor & Energy Materials , an Orbia business, is looking for a SAP Technical support leader (ABAP/BASIS) to be based at México, Colombia or Brazil !


Job Summary/ Purpose

Our team, the Service Delivery Management for Global Applications, is responsible to ensure operational continuity of Orbia’s Global Business Applications like SAP ECC, S/4, CFIN, SuccessFactors and others. The support of these applications is under a Managed Service partner, and our role is to supervise and ensure that this service is delivered to Orbia’s standards of quality and following our processes and policies. This role will have a specific responsibility over initiatives that require Developments in those applications, by supporting and monitoring the service of the AMS (Application Managed Support) partners, defining and enforcing best practices and security standards, and providing operational support when needed (e.g. in case of escalations, issues with in-house developed apps or legacy apps).


Main Responsibilities

  • Creation of best practices and operational processes related to Application Development in SAP ECC and S/4 (ABAP, BTP, Fiori).
  • On a general note and not restricted to Development initiatives: Being a point of contact for Orbia’s companies located in LATAM, guiding them through our Service Delivery Model when needed and ensuring that they get the right support on time.
  • Provide operational support (in collaboration with the AMS partner) to application/integrations developed in-house or other developments in Legacy Applications when needed. Provide ideas to the Application Solution leads for those Legacy apps/integrations to be included the target architecture roadmap. Support their transition to target architecture when needed (e.g. from a local application to S/4 BTP portals or apps).
  • Ensure that developments or customizations in the S/4 applications are done following the Digital Decoupling strategy as defined by the Orbia Global Applications team.
  • Support and drive automation initiatives where possible, with a final goal of incident reduction and self-service (e.g. self-healing, monitoring and alert systems, automation of standard requests, etc.).
  • Drive and encourage new ways of working in collaboration with the AMS partner, for example Devops or Scrum.
  • Participation in the major incident process when needed, for Americas’ applications/time zones.
  • Participation in CAB or coordination with IT Service Desk meetings when needed.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Spanish.


Knowledge/ Experience Required

  • Good understanding of SAP ECC and S/4 Technical and Development functionalities (BTP, Basis, ABAP, Fiori/JAVA, etc.).
  • Good knowledge of ITIL framework.
  • Ability to take on the above-mentioned responsibilities with a constructive and collaborative approach.
  • Passion for Service standardization and improvement.
  • Excellent people skills, ability to manage escalations from business colleagues from all levels of the organization.
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines when needed.
  • Able to manage and prioritize tasks and time efficiently, and coordinate efforts with external partners in an effective manner.
  • Able to demonstrate initiative and a proactive approach to daily tasks.


Behaviors that can help you succeed at Orbia:

  • Develop yourself & Others
  • Foster Collaboration & Inclusion
  • Drive Results
  • Provide Vision & Direction


We welcome purpose-driven dreamers, doers, and builders, recognizing that it takes difference to make a difference. If you’re ready to bring your skills, talents, and perspective to moving your career, the company, people, and the planet forward, we’d like to hear from you.

We believe that every voice matters; every community deserves respect; and every challenge is an opportunity and united by empathy, we are stronger for our different perspectives. We are dedicated to building a more diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace that supports the needs of all our employees regardless of their role, location, identity, and background.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Managerto join our team. As a rapidly growing company, we are looking for talented individuals committed to helping us achieve our goals. In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with a team of driven individuals dedicated to making a difference in the industry.



Responsibilities

  • Propose innovative ideas based on the current status of the categories, as well as create and implement projects through resource integration and merchant guidance.
  • Conduct industry analysis reports, explore potential customer needs through data analysis, and adjust strategies accordingly based on market trends.

  • 5+ years of operational experience, including but not limited to experience in brand management or platform operations.

  • Possesses market exploration and marketing innovation capabilities, capable of guiding overall merchant marketing plans.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, self-motivation, ability to think strategically and adapt quickly to changes.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage logistics during high-demand periods.

title: Analista Tributário Jr
description:
Já pensou em Somar no CSC de um dos maiores grupos empresariais do Brasil?

Somos o UltraCSC+, um Centro de Soluções Compartilhadas criado para facilitar a gestão do dia a dia das empresas do Grupo Ultra, promovendo mais eficiência e produtividade em processos transacionais.


Você soma com nosso crescimento!

Aqui você é o protagonista da transformação que queremos. A sua paixão, senso de dono, responsabilidade e inconformismo são os combustíveis para chegarmos mais longe.


E sobre a vaga?

Atuará na gestão da regularidade fiscal das empresas, bem como, no atendimento aos questionamentos e solicitações de informações efetuadas pelo fisco.


Você focará em:

  • Analisar e revisar obrigações acessórias (DCTF, ECF, EFD, etc);
  • Analisar documentos fiscais, livros contábeis e documentos gerenciais necessários para atendimento de procedimentos fiscalizatórios;
  • Preparar parecer técnico tributário / fiscal, bem como book de documentos que o embase a análise;
  • Identificar eventuais riscos fiscais e propor eventuais soluções;
  • Apoiar na renovação, aquisição e controle de certificados digitais;
  • Renovar as certidões tributárias federais e dar as devidas tratativas para eventuais pendências que impeçam a renovação automática das certidões;
  • Leitura das caixas postais eletrônicas disponíveis no e-CAC;
  • Trabalhar em colaboração com as equipes internas, como contabilidade, tributária e jurídico
  • Realizar conciliação de depósitos judiciais;
  • Analisar e realizar movimentações contábeis relativas as provisões jurídicas, bem com seus impactos nos resultados operacionais e financeiros;
  • Acompanhar e realizar análises comparativas das contingências possíveis e remotas.


Como requisitos básicos, você deve ter:

  • Superior completo em Contábeis e áreas correlatas;
  • Conhecimento básico de legislação tributária federal, estadual e municipais;
  • Conhecimento na confecção e retificações de obrigações acessórias;
  • Experiência com e-CAC e suas funcionalidades;
  • Conhecimento básico em contabilidade (compreensão e aplicabilidade dos princípios contábeis);
  • Boa comunicação e redação.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
For many of us, there’s that one podcast we never miss, and video content is part of our daily routine, whether it’s professional or personal. But how many of us truly understand the effort that goes on behind the scenes? Here at Riverside, we know it well. That’s exactly why we built an AI-powered platform that helps content creators, podcasters, marketeers, and more at major brands like Netflix, Disney, Google, and Microsoft to create high-quality content with ease.

Riverside’s technology streamlines the entire content creation process, turning ideas into professional-grade content with the highest production standards, without requiring expensive equipment or external services. The secret? AI-driven tools that replace traditional production roles like editing, directing, and design, automating the entire process at the click of a button.


About the Engineering Team

We’re a team of smart, curious engineers building scalable, reliable systems that power content creation for millions. We work with modern web technologies, tackle real-world challenges in distributed systems, and keep things practical-no over-engineering, just solid solutions. If you love solving tough problems, moving fast, and building tech that creators actually use, you’ll fit right in.


On your day to day

We’re looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer (Remote) who’s passionate about technology, performance, and crafting amazing user experiences. You’ll join a global, distributed team working on the core of our platform - where most of the content of our users is being created, where stability and performance are key.


Tech Stack: TypeScript • React • Redux • Nest.js • Node.js • MongoDB • AWS


What You’ll Do:

  • Build and ship end-to-end features that power our recording & live-call experience
  • Design and maintain scalable microservices
  • Prototype quickly, iterate fast, and deliver impact
  • Collaborate with product, design & growth teams to improve UX
  • Use data to guide decisions and enhance performance

Why You’ll Love It

  • Work with a passionate, remote-first team
  • Shape the product used by thousands of creators
  • Competitive pay + flexibility + autonomy

If you love building seamless, high-performance web experiences - we’d love to meet you.


What Will Make You Stand Out?

  • Degree in Computer Science or equivalent real-world experience
  • 8+ years of software development experience
  • Deep expertise in React and JavaScript/TypeScript , applying modern best practices, design patterns, and clean code principles
  • Good experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and RESTful APIs
  • Proven experience working in remote and distributed teams
  • Excellent communication and teamwork in English
  • Bonus: Experience with Websockets, WebRTC, MediaStream, and browser APIs for audio/video

Bottom line? If you wanna take part in transforming how people and businesses share their stories globally, Riverside’s your place. The work is challenging, the culture is fast-paced, and the people are exceptionally brilliant. And if that’s not enough, we guarantee that your ideas will genuinely make an impact.

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Software Backend - Sênior (Python)
description:
O seu papel como Software Engineer Senior (E3)

  • Desenvolver soluções de ponta a ponta em Python , desde a definição de arquitetura até testes e rollout em produção;
  • Projetar e evoluir sistemas com foco em automação , direcionados à eficiência operacional do grupo SBF;
  • Garantir funcionalidade, manutenibilidade, escalabilidade e qualidade , aplicando boas práticas de engenharia e testes;
  • Trabalhar em um ambiente colaborativo, com pair programming, feedbacks contínuos e cultura de alta performance .


O que você precisa para essa posição no jogo

  • Proficiência avançada em Python (orientação a objetos, concorrência, boas práticas de código);
  • Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em Docker & Kubernetes para implantação escalável de modelos e serviços;
  • Conhecimento em observabilidade e monitoramento aplicados a sistemas de IA e automação;
  • Sólida prática em testes unitários, integração e validação de modelos;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente multifuncional e colaborativo , com autonomia;
  • Embasamento teórico em ciência de dados, aprendizado de máquina e boas práticas de engenharia de software (DDD, design de código, paradigmas);
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).


Seria legal se você conhecesse

  • Google Cloud AI/ML Services (Vertex AI, AI Platform);
  • Continuous Integration & Delivery aplicados a ML (CI/CD para pipelines de dados e modelos);
  • Ferramentas de processamento de dados em streaming (Kafka, Pub/Sub);
  • Boas práticas de DataOps e integração com times de dados e automação.

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.

  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.


Experiência em análise de performance e troubleshooting

  • Identificação e resolução de gargalos de performance em aplicações e banco de dados.
  • Uso de ferramentas de profiling e análise de logs.
  • Experiência em logs estruturados e telemetria  (Application Insights, Serilog, Sentry, etc.).


Vivência em times ágeis

  • Experiência trabalhando em squads com Scrum ou Kanban.
  • Participação em cerimônias (daily, planning, review e retrospectiva).
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa em ambientes distribuídos/remotos.


    • Experiências Desejáveis (não obrigatórias, mas valorizadas)
    • Projetos com DDD (Domain-Driven Design) , eventos de domínio e mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka, Azure Service Bus).
    • Experiência implementando estratégias de resiliência  (retry, fallback, circuit breaker).
    • Projetos de monitoramento avançado com telemetria e métricas de performance.
    • Participação em arquiteturas escaláveis e de alta disponibilidade.



    Diferenciais
    • Ter trabalhado com Ext.js  em sistemas legados.
    • Experiência em Blazor  (Server ou WebAssembly).
    • Portfólio com projetos relevantes em produção.

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

English fluently

Proven 2+ end-to-end MCP-based agent orchestration implementations.

Strong expertise in Python, AWS Bedrock, LangChain, or similar frameworks.

Experienced Generative AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy scalable multi-agent systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP)

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of software development experience, including 3+ years as an AI Engineer delivering multiple production-grade AI solutions, and at least 2 complete end-to-end AI/MCP-based orchestration projects, including knowledge of benchmarking and guardrails.


You will lead the design and integration of LLM-driven agents, build modular toolchains, and ensure seamless orchestration across enterprise-grade research applications.


Solid understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), API integration, and LLM orchestration.


Experience with CI/CD, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and monitoring AI pipelines.


Excellent communication skills and the ability to work in a cross-disciplinary research environment.


What can you expect from us?

• Professional development and constant evolution of your skills, always in line with your interests.

• Opportunities to work outside Brazil

• A collaborative, diverse and innovative environment that encourages teamwork.

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.
  • Documentação de APIs (Swagger, OpenAPI).


Aplicação de boas práticas de engenharia de software

  • Experiência comprovada com Clean Code, SOLID e princípios de design .
  • Criação de código escalável, legível e sustentável.
  • Participação em code reviews  e manutenção de padrões de qualidade.

title: Gen AI Developer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for (job name) who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will: (responsibilities)

English fluently

Proven 2+ end-to-end MCP-based agent orchestration implementations.

Strong expertise in Python, AWS Bedrock, LangChain, or similar frameworks.

Experienced Generative AI Engineer to design, build, and deploy scalable multi-agent systems using Model Context Protocol (MCP)

The ideal candidate has 5+ years of software development experience, including 3+ years as an AI Engineer delivering multiple production-grade AI solutions, and at least 2 complete end-to-end AI/MCP-based orchestration projects, including knowledge of benchmarking and guardrails.


You will lead the design and integration of LLM-driven agents, build modular toolchains, and ensure seamless orchestration across enterprise-grade research applications.


Solid understanding of retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), API integration, and LLM orchestration.

title: Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno
description:
Descrição da Empresa Handcom é especializada em fornecer soluções de software para gestão de armazéns e centros de distribuição. Com o nosso sistema Mobilize WMS, oferecemos uma solução completa para otimizar e gerenciar eficientemente as operações logísticas dos nossos clientes. A Handcom também fornece soluções de gestão de ativos e inventários utilizando RFID através do Mobilize IoT. Fundada em 2007, temos casos de sucesso reconhecidos no mercado nacional e somos premiados pela Fundação Nacional da Qualidade com o prêmio faixa ouro. Nosso propósito é empoderar pessoas que movem o mundo para o futuro.


Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Analista de Sistemas .Net Pleno para se juntar à nossa equipe. Este cargo envolve desenvolvimento e manutenção de aplicações .Net, garantindo performance e qualidade do código. As responsabilidades incluem a implementação de novas funcionalidades no sistema, realização de testes, depuração e otimização. Este é um cargo de tempo integral dedicado e remoto.


Experiências Exigidas – Desenvolvedor Pleno .NET C#

Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento back-end com .NET/C#

  • Vivência prática de pelo menos 3 anos  atuando em projetos profissionais.
  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e serviços com ASP.NET Core .


Excelência em acesso a dados com Entity Framework Core

  • Experiência em criação, manutenção e otimização de consultas LINQ e SQL.
  • Uso avançado de migrations, mapeamento de entidades e relações complexas.
  • Ajuste de performance em queries e análise de planos de execução.


Prática em desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful

  • Implementação de endpoints seguros, versionados e performáticos.
  • Integração com sistemas externos e consumo de serviços.

Com mais de 35 anos de mercado e localizada em 16 países, a GFT emprega mais de 10.000 pessoas ao redor do mundo sendo 3.000 pessoas no Brasil.

Aqui, a diversidade, a igualdade e a inclusão estão no centro e garantir um ambiente de trabalho seguro para todas as pessoas faz parte de quem somos.

O que estamos buscando?


Engenharia de Dados AWS Sênior - ID

Linguagem de Programação: Python, SQL, Scala, Pyspark, Shell Script. Fundamentos: DataMesh, Database SQL e NoSQL, Hadoop Ecossistema, Engenharia de Software, Privacidade e Segurança. Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;

  • Tenha habilidades de resolução de problemas ;
  • Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e gerenciar o próprio tempo ;
  • Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e inovadoras no âmbito tecnológico.

Cartão multi-benefícios – você escolhe como e onde utilizar;

Bolsas de Estudos para cursos de Graduação, Pós, MBA e Idiomas;

Programas de incentivo à Certificações;

Horário de trabalho flexível;

Plano personalizado de carreira e possibilidade de carreira internacional;

Salários competitivos;

Avaliação de desempenho anual com possibilidade de bonificação;

Gympass;

Previdência Privada;

Auxílio-Creche;

Assistência Médica;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida.
